items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I had Bud Roussel, Farstown, Dude, Yalla, Lil' Dad. Piano player? I think Lil' Arthur was on saxophone or clarinet.

ctx.x: Who was in that band? I didn't get that straight.
I had Bud Roussel, Farstown, Dude, Yalla, Lil' Dad. Piano player? I think Lil' Arthur was on saxophone or clarinet. Lil' who?
